summary: The test compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly but the test title does not preserve the testCaseId (TC-001). The selector is somewhat specific but could be more robust. The URL assertion uses a weak regex that may pass for unrelated URLs containing 'product'. The test is functional but lacks strong assertions to confirm the correct product detail page is displayed.

issues.description: The test title does not include or preserve the testCaseId 'TC-001', making traceability to requirements less clear.
issues.recommendation: Include the testCaseId in the test title to ensure traceability, e.g., 'TC-001: Verify Product Detail Page is Displayed'.

issues.description: The URL assertion uses a loose regex /product/ which could pass URLs that do not uniquely identify the product detail page.
issues.recommendation: Make the URL assertion more specific to ensure it validates navigation to the intended product detail page, for example by including product ID or full path.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is specific but hardcoded, which might reduce test maintainability if product IDs change.
issues.recommendation: Consider parameterizing the product selector or using data-test attributes that better reflect the test intent for improved robustness.

recommendations: Preserve testCaseId identifiers in test titles for better requirement traceability.
Enhance URL assertions to uniquely identify the navigated product detail page.
Review selectors for maintainability and potential parameterization to support test scalability.
